about: Items from sir's Speaking guide (seed/sources/guides/IELTS_Speaking_Guide_book_full.html) that the bank did not already cover. Everything else in the guide's Part 1 topic bank and 40-card bank duplicates the bank and is left out. Cards are matched by their prompt; Part 3 links point at existing bank topics (which carry sample answers).

cards.title: Describe a person who taught you something useful.
Describe a place you visited that was very different from where you live.
Describe a place where you like to study or work.
Describe something you bought that you were not happy with.
Describe a sporting event you watched or took part in.
Describe a time when the weather changed your plans.
Describe a job you would like to do in the future.
